moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' Breaks UK Chart Record
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's duet 'Rein Me In' has become the longest-running UK Number 1 single ever, with 19 non-consecutive weeks at the top of the Official Singles Chart as of July 31st.

angles.name: Chart History Made
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is officially the longest-running UK Number 1 single ever. 19 weeks at the top!

angles.name: Celebrating Success
angles.copy: Huge congratulations to Sam Fender and Olivia Dean! 'Rein Me In' has broken a 73-year record. What a track!
